tagline.en: NVIDIA GEAR's DreamZero — an Apache-2.0 world-action model that predicts video and robot actions from camera observations.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA GEAR 的 DreamZero——Apache-2.0 许可的世界-动作模型,从相机观测预测视频与机器人动作。

en: DreamZero is an embodied world-action model from NVIDIA's GEAR-Dreams, released under Apache-2.0. It takes camera and proprioceptive observations from a robot and predicts both future video and the actions to take, making it a policy for real-world manipulation.

It ships in two checkpoints — one trained on DROID and one on AgiBot — and builds on a Wan2.1-I2V-14B video backbone with a UMT5 text encoder. In WorldFoundry the default 14B server runs across two CUDA ranks, while a lighter Wan2.2 5B entrypoint can run on a single rank. The policy follows the DROID/RoboArena observation contract: two external cameras, a wrist camera, joint and gripper positions, and a prompt.
In WorldFoundry, DreamZero runs as a distributed policy server that a WebSocket client drives; it emits action-trace artifacts and preserves the predicted-video contract in metadata.
zh: DreamZero 是 NVIDIA GEAR-Dreams 推出的具身世界-动作模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它接收机器人的相机与本体感知观测,同时预测未来视频与要执行的动作,可作为真实世界操作任务的策略。

它提供两个 checkpoint——一个在 DROID 上训练、一个在 AgiBot 上训练——构建于 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 视频骨干之上,配 UMT5 文本编码器。在 WorldFoundry 中,默认 14B 服务跨两个 CUDA rank 运行,而更轻量的 Wan2.2 5B 入口可在单个 rank 上运行。该策略遵循 DROID/RoboArena 观测约定:两路外部相机、一路腕部相机、关节与夹爪位置,以及提示词。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DreamZero 作为分布式策略服务运行,由 WebSocket 客户端驱动;它产出 action-trace 产物,并在元数据中保留预测视频的约定。

whenToUse.en: Use DreamZero when you want an embodied world-action policy that predicts both video and robot actions from multi-camera observations, in the DROID/RoboArena setup.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个具身的世界-动作策略,在 DROID/RoboArena 设定下从多相机观测同时预测视频与机器人动作时,适合使用 DreamZero。

notFor.en: It's a robot policy, not a general text-to-video generator, and expects the DROID/RoboArena observation setup. Checkpoint-backed execution needs a staged DROID or AgiBot checkpoint and a compatible multi-GPU CUDA topology.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人策略,而非通用的文生视频生成器,并需要 DROID/RoboArena 的观测设定。基于 checkpoint 的运行需要就位的 DROID 或 AgiBot checkpoint,以及兼容的多 GPU CUDA 拓扑。

en: Apache-2.0 embodied world-action model from NVIDIA GEAR
Predicts both future video and robot actions
DROID and AgiBot checkpoints on a Wan2.1-I2V-14B backbone
Runs as a distributed policy server driven over WebSocket
zh: NVIDIA GEAR 推出的 Apache-2.0 具身世界-动作模型
同时预测未来视频与机器人动作
DROID 与 AgiBot 两个 checkpoint,基于 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 骨干
